title: Alvin Kamara 'couldn't be happier' about Saints' Travis Etienne Jr. signing

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Alvin Kamara 'couldn't be happier' about Saints' Travis Etienne Jr. signing
sources.description: The Saints signed Travis Etienne Jr. to a lucrative contract in free agency. His running mate, Alvin Kamara, 'couldn't be happier' about the deal.
